segments.name: GeneDx
segments.description: Provides exome and genome sequencing and interpretation to clinicians diagnosing rare genetic disease in pediatric and adult patients.
segments.evidence: With 25 years of operation, GeneDx has a proven track record of expertise in genetic testing, particularly exome and genome testing.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Collects non-testing revenue from the Fabric Genomics platform and legacy operations, including data and biopharma programs.
segments.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, Other represents revenues of the Fabric Genomics and Legacy Sema4 operating segments.
